# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna  <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"
dir_ref   <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/ref"
gse_path  <- "F:/wd/deposit_dataset/GSE155096_MetS_microRNA_NGS.txt/GSE155096_MetS_microRNA_NGS.txt"
dir_out   <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/02_GSE155096_homolog"
dir.create(dir_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

homolog_tsv <- file.path(dir_ref, "TargetScan_v8.0",
                         "homologous_miRNA_mmu_hsa.txt")

# Auto-detect latest miRNA maSigPro output directory
find_mirna_masigpro_dir <- function() {
  base <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "01_maSigPro")
  all_dated <- sort(list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE),
                    decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in all_dated) {
    if (length(list.files(d, pattern = "^Plasma_miRNA_ids_clst_")) > 0) return(d)
  }
  stop("miRNA maSigPro output not found")
}

dir_masigpro <- find_mirna_masigpro_dir()

cat("maSigPro dir:", dir_masigpro, "\n")
cat("Homolog file:", homolog_tsv,  "\n")
cat("GSE155096   :", gse_path,     "\n")
cat("Output dir  :", dir_out,      "\n")
```

# 3. Load mouse maSigPro miRNAs

```{r load-mouse-mirna}
mouse_mirna <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  f <- file.path(dir_masigpro, paste0("Plasma_miRNA_ids_clst_", i, ".csv"))
  read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::rename(mmu_miRNA = miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster = cluster)

cat("Mouse maSigPro miRNAs:", nrow(mouse_mirna), "\n")
print(table(mouse_mirna$miRNA_cluster))
```

# 4. Load homology table (TargetScan v8.0, mmu × hsa)

```{r load-homolog}
homolog_raw <- read.delim(homolog_tsv, header = TRUE,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# Expand to one row per mmu miRNA × hsa miRNA pair
homolog_pairs <- homolog_raw %>%
  filter(mmu_n_miRNA > 0, hsa_n_miRNA > 0) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mmu_list = list(trimws(strsplit(mmu_MiRBase_IDs, ";")[[1]])),
    hsa_list = list(trimws(strsplit(hsa_MiRBase_IDs, ";")[[1]]))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(mmu_list) %>%
  unnest(hsa_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    miR_family       = `miR family`,
    seed             = `Seed+m8`,
    conservation     = `Family Conservation?`,
    mmu_miRNA        = mmu_list,
    hsa_miRNA        = hsa_list
  ) %>%
  filter(mmu_miRNA != "", hsa_miRNA != "")

cat("Homologous pairs (mmu × hsa):", nrow(homolog_pairs), "\n")
cat("Unique mouse miRNAs:", n_distinct(homolog_pairs$mmu_miRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique human miRNAs:", n_distinct(homolog_pairs$hsa_miRNA), "\n")
```

# 5. Load GSE155096 human miRNA data

```{r load-gse}
gse_raw <- read.delim(gse_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

id_col  <- colnames(gse_raw)[1]
samples <- colnames(gse_raw)[-1]

# Sample group annotation
sample_meta <- tibble(sample = samples) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    grepl("^C", sample) ~ "Control",
    grepl("^T", sample) ~ "Treatment",
    TRUE                ~ "Other"
  ))

cat("Human miRNA features:", nrow(gse_raw), "\n")
cat("Samples:", paste(samples, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 6. Match: mouse maSigPro miRNAs → human homologs

```{r match-homologs}
# Join maSigPro miRNAs with homology table
matched <- mouse_mirna %>%
  inner_join(homolog_pairs, by = "mmu_miRNA") %>%
  dplyr::select(mmu_miRNA, miRNA_cluster, miR_family,
                seed, conservation, hsa_miRNA)

cat("Mouse maSigPro miRNAs with human homologs:", n_distinct(matched$mmu_miRNA), "\n")
cat("Corresponding human miRNAs              :", n_distinct(matched$hsa_miRNA), "\n")

# Filter to human miRNAs present in GSE155096
hsa_in_gse <- unique(gse_raw[[id_col]])
matched_in_gse <- matched %>%
  filter(hsa_miRNA %in% hsa_in_gse)

cat("\nHuman miRNAs found in GSE155096:", n_distinct(matched_in_gse$hsa_miRNA), "\n")
cat("Corresponding mouse miRNAs      :", n_distinct(matched_in_gse$mmu_miRNA), "\n")

print(as_tibble(matched_in_gse), n = Inf)

write.csv(matched_in_gse,
          file.path(dir_out, "homolog_pairs_matched_in_GSE155096.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: homolog_pairs_matched_in_GSE155096.csv\n")
```

# 7. Extract and reshape expression of matched human miRNAs

```{r extract-expr}
target_hsa <- unique(matched_in_gse$hsa_miRNA)

# Average duplicate miRNA rows (same ID appearing multiple times)
gse_filtered <- gse_raw %>%
  filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% target_hsa) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(samples), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(hsa_miRNA = 1)

cat("Human miRNAs extracted:", nrow(gse_filtered), "\n")

# Long format with group annotation
expr_long <- gse_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(-hsa_miRNA, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expr") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    log2expr = log2(expr + 1),
    group    = factor(group, levels = c("Control", "Treatment"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    matched_in_gse %>% distinct(hsa_miRNA, mmu_miRNA, miRNA_cluster,
                                miR_family, conservation),
    by = "hsa_miRNA"
  )
```

# 8. C vs T statistical comparison

```{r stats-cvsT}
# Wilcoxon rank-sum test per human miRNA (log2-scale)
stats_res <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(hsa_miRNA, mmu_miRNA, miRNA_cluster, miR_family, conservation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_C  = mean(log2expr[group == "Control"],   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_T  = mean(log2expr[group == "Treatment"], na.rm = TRUE),
    log2FC  = mean_T - mean_C,
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(log2expr[group == "Control"],
                  log2expr[group == "Treatment"],
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj     = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig       = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
      TRUE           ~ "n.s."
    ),
    direction = if_else(log2FC > 0, "Up in T", "Down in T")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

cat("Statistical results:\n")
print(as_tibble(stats_res), n = Inf)

write.csv(stats_res,
          file.path(dir_out, "CvsT_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: CvsT_stats.csv\n")
```

# 9. Visualization

## 9a. Boxplots — all matched miRNAs

```{r boxplots, results='asis', fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD", "2" = "#FDCDAC", "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4", "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

for (hsa in unique(stats_res$hsa_miRNA)) {

  row_stat <- stats_res %>% filter(hsa_miRNA == hsa)
  mmu_label <- paste(unique(row_stat$mmu_miRNA), collapse = "; ")
  clst_label <- paste(unique(row_stat$miRNA_cluster), collapse = "/")
  clst_col   <- MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS[as.character(row_stat$miRNA_cluster[1])]

  df_plot <- expr_long %>% filter(hsa_miRNA == hsa)

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = group, y = log2expr, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5,
                 linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2.0, alpha = 0.9,
                color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#9ecae1",
                                 "Treatment" = "#fc9272"),
                      guide = "none") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(df_plot$log2expr) * 1.05,
             label = paste0("p = ", signif(row_stat$p_value, 2),
                            "  |  FDR = ", signif(row_stat$p_adj, 2),
                            "\nlog2FC = ", round(row_stat$log2FC, 2)),
             size = 3.2, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20") +
    labs(
      title    = hsa,
      subtitle = paste0("Mouse homolog: ", mmu_label,
                        "  |  Cluster ", clst_label),
      x = NULL, y = "log2(1 + expression)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                   color = clst_col),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40",
                                   hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )

  cat("\n\n###", hsa, "\n\n")
  print(p)

  ggsave(file.path(dir_out,
                   paste0("boxplot_CvsT_", gsub("[:/]", "_", hsa), ".svg")),
         p, width = 5, height = 4)
}
```

## 9b. Summary: log2FC ranked plot

```{r fc-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Deduplicate by hsa_miRNA: one hsa miRNA may map to multiple mouse miRNAs/clusters
# Keep the mouse cluster with the smallest cluster number for coloring
plot_fc <- stats_res %>%
  group_by(hsa_miRNA) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = miRNA_cluster, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(log2FC) %>%
  mutate(
    hsa_short     = sub("^hsa-", "", hsa_miRNA),
    hsa_short     = factor(hsa_short, levels = unique(hsa_short)),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster), levels = 1:5)
  )

p_fc <- ggplot(plot_fc,
               aes(x = hsa_short, y = log2FC, fill = miRNA_cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 3, color = "grey20", fill = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Mouse\ncluster",
                    values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 8,
                                "p < 0.05"   = 21,
                                "n.s."        = 32)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title    = "C vs T log2 fold change — human homologs of mouse maSigPro miRNAs",
    subtitle = "Ranked by log2FC (Treatment / Control)",
    x = NULL, y = "log2FC (Treatment \u2212 Control)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )

print(p_fc)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "log2FC_ranked.svg"), p_fc, width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "log2FC_ranked.png"), p_fc, width = 8, height = 5,
       dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: log2FC_ranked.svg / .png\n")
```

## 9c. Heatmap: matched miRNA expression across samples

```{r heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
# Wide matrix: miRNA × sample (log2 scale)
mat <- gse_filtered %>%
  column_to_rownames("hsa_miRNA") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ log2(.x + 1))) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Order rows by log2FC (deduplicate: one row per hsa_miRNA)
row_order <- stats_res %>%
  group_by(hsa_miRNA) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = miRNA_cluster, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(log2FC) %>%
  pull(hsa_miRNA) %>%
  unique()
row_order <- row_order[row_order %in% rownames(mat)]
mat <- mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

# Cluster annotation for rows
row_ann <- stats_res %>%
  dplyr::select(hsa_miRNA, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(hsa_miRNA %in% rownames(mat)) %>%
  arrange(match(hsa_miRNA, rownames(mat)))

mat_long <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("hsa_miRNA") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hsa_miRNA, names_to = "sample", values_to = "log2expr") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(stats_res %>% dplyr::select(hsa_miRNA, miRNA_cluster, log2FC,
                                         p_value, sig),
            by = "hsa_miRNA") %>%
  mutate(
    hsa_short = sub("^hsa-", "", hsa_miRNA),
    hsa_short = factor(hsa_short,
                       levels = sub("^hsa-", "", row_order)),
    sample    = factor(sample, levels = samples)
  )

p_heat <- ggplot(mat_long,
                 aes(x = sample, y = hsa_short, fill = log2expr)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low  = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#d6604d",
    midpoint = median(mat_long$log2expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "log2(1+expr)"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = sum(sample_meta$group == "Control") + 0.5,
             color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = sum(sample_meta$group == "Control") / 2 + 0.2,
           y = nrow(mat) + 0.7, label = "Control", size = 3.5,
           fontface = "bold", color = "#2166ac") +
  annotate("text",
           x = sum(sample_meta$group == "Control") +
             sum(sample_meta$group == "Treatment") / 2 + 0.5,
           y = nrow(mat) + 0.7, label = "Treatment", size = 3.5,
           fontface = "bold", color = "#d6604d") +
  labs(
    title    = "Human homolog miRNA expression — GSE155096",
    subtitle = "Rows ordered by log2FC (low \u2192 high); log2(1+x) scale",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_heat)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "heatmap_homolog_expression.svg"),
       p_heat, width = 7, height = max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.45 + 2))
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "heatmap_homolog_expression.png"),
       p_heat, width = 7, height = max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.45 + 2), dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: heatmap_homolog_expression.svg / .png\n")
```
